Asset type: production pixel-art cliff EDGE CAP texture atlas for the side-scrolling Filipino game O.B.R.A.

One genuinely transparent 1536x1024 PNG, exactly THREE equal vertical columns with wide transparent gutters. Column 2: exposed charcoal/slate-purple columnar basalt, vertical angular fracture faces, sparse ochre weathering concentrated on the top lip; NO grass.
Column 3: pale warm-grey volcanic ash crust over muted mauve-grey weathered stone, thin dusty beige lip and chipped coarse face; NO snow, NO grass.

Match the reference's actual materials closely. Broad readable stone masses, subtle crisp hand-clustered 16-bit pixel art, sparse dither, quiet textured planes, warm upper-left lighting. Keep the top-most grass/crust level, outer edge naturally chipped rather than ruler-straight, and the overlap side irregular. Preserve true alpha transparency around and between all three pieces. No text, labels, frames, ground shadow, sky, water, UI, checkerboard or colored backdrop.
